description: The torsion half of Calugareanu is not an isotopy invariant, the curvature half's infimum is. Standard torus embeddings of T(2,3), T(2,5), T(2,7) along a family r -> 0: total curvature decreases toward Milnor's floor 4*pi (bridge number 2) and stays above it; total torsion and writhe vary across the family while Wr + Tw_F is an integer at every r. Hence the fractional framing scalar the hull exit needs cannot be an isotopy invariant of the closure; the substrate's fractional twist is algebraic or nothing. mpmath quadrature at 24 dps, no float64 in the hot path.
caveats: The torus embedding is a convenience, not a canonical realisation; every torsion and writhe number here is a property of that embedding and of r, which is the point being made. A canonical embedding (Mobius-energy or ropelength minimiser) would give canonical numbers, and would still not give an isotopy invariant.

Writhe is a trapezoid x panelled Gauss-Legendre double integral in (t, u = s - t) coordinates, checked only through the integrality of Wr + Tw_F (residual reported as worst_Lk_integrality_residual); its absolute accuracy is well below the 24-dps working precision of the single integrals.
Per component only. A realisation of the whole chain link is not constructed; the principle does not depend on it.
